text: The dungeon door opens onto one shared room whose landmarks do not move when perception changes. A large brown horse waits beside the rack, watching the party for a humane choice.

views.text: A bright clover meadow spreads beyond the door. A white unicorn stands in the sun, its head turned toward the party.
A filthy torture room holds a rack, manacles, and an iron maiden. A large brown horse stands beside them, inexplicably calm.
